sources.entry: APPLORE - AI app icon generator plus a library of 18,000+ real App Store and Google Play icons for reference. #freemium #design

summary.name: APPLORE AI App Icon Generator
summary.one_liner: A web tool that generates original app icons from a text description, optionally borrowing the style of any of 18,000+ real App Store and Google Play icons.
keywords: app icon sizes ios android web
use_cases: Creating a first app icon from a one-sentence description
Borrowing the visual style of popular App Store icons
Generating several icon variations with different image models
Refining an existing icon with text instructions
Exporting icons in App Store, Android and web sizes
summary.what_it_does: Users describe their app in a sentence, optionally add a name and things to avoid, then pick a style or a reference icon from a library of 18,000+ App Store and Google Play icons, or upload their own images. The tool generates up to 4 icons at a time using one of six image models (GPT Image 2.5, GPT Image 2, Grok Imagine 2, Nano Banana 2, Seedream 5.0 Flash, Qwen Image 3.0). Icons can be refined with text instructions or reused as form inputs. Outputs are 1024 × 1024 PNG, with SVG and multi-size packs for iOS, Android and web mentioned.
notable: Style borrowing from 18,000+ real App Store and Google Play icons, with the output kept original
Six selectable image models, including GPT Image 2.5 for lettering and Qwen Image 3.0 for Chinese text
Refine option uses an existing icon as reference for the next version
Exports 1024 × 1024 PNG, SVG, or a pack with all iOS, Android and web sizes
caveats: Free tier gives 10 credits (about two icons); each icon costs 5–15 credits depending on model
Icons must not reproduce another brand's logo, per the page's guidance
